structural_finding.issue: The source bootstrap reconstructs every target and control level as I(1). The marginal residual-unit-root null for one target does not imply that the target-excluded nuisance controls are all I(1). For stationary, mixed-order or cointegrated controls this changes the nuisance factor process rather than conditioning on it.
structural_finding.candidate_contract: Hold the target-excluded control panel fixed, block-resample increments of the fitted target residual, reconstruct a unit-root residual path, add it back to the fitted common component, and re-estimate the target regression/residual statistic in each replication.
structural_finding.multiplicity_note: Dependence-robust multiplicity remains a separate requirement; ordinary BH dependence was already audited in PR 474.

deterministic_stationary_control_fixture.interpretation: The fixture is synthetic size/power evidence only. It does not estimate Polymarket false-discovery rate or PnL. It demonstrates that forcing stationary nuisance controls to I(1) can materially reduce power even while the target residual alternative is unchanged.

required_successor_test: Do not reopen the rejected PR 466 unchanged.
If PCA is revisited, compare its frozen all-series-I1 p-values with conditional target-residual unit-root p-values on the identical pre-specified chronological panel.
Use a dependence-robust multiplicity procedure or prove a valid dependence condition before threshold aggression.
For a single-leg implementation include common-factor forecast variance/covariance in the horizon PnL distribution; residual variance alone is not total single-leg risk.
Require point-in-time/forward universe evidence and shared-ledger fill-conditioned PnL at 1x, 1.5x and 2x costs before integration.
